Tired of centralized profiling and predictable network telemetry? NoiseBox DNS Shuffler is an independent browser extension that quietly generates background DNS noise, helping you reclaim control over your browsing metadata. Fully client-side, lightweight, and open source. 🛡️

Get the source code here: https://codeberg.org/NoiseBoxWorks/NoiseBox_DNS_Shuffler
